payload.Title: User message awaiting request triage (ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous, ambiguous)

observation.prompt_text:
<!-- reply -->
> Your decision — audio transcription is blocked. Antigravity (agy), the only agent tool here that can listen to audio, is shut off by the fleet router. The test that should lift that block produced nothing. I filed that, plus the router wrongly marking the harness PR as failed, as two harness bug reports.

you can run antigravity for this. the fleet router should allow overrides when permission is granted, and i grant it. first make sure the newest harness is installed, check to see if that issue is still there, if it is, make the fix and submit a pr, and then run it on agy. but also go ahead and find the biggest good audio model that can transcribe and go ahead and download that as well for future use.
